verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party (claimed-docs) benchmark tables, latency, or recall numbers for HelixDB; the only performance data referenced comes from community discussion (e.g., a mention of a benchmark page running on 5M records with 5s count(*) latency, and unanswered questions about p99 multi-hop latency), which is not corroborated by any vendor-tier documentation in this pack. Because disputed verdicts require citations from two distinct tiers and only community-tier evidence exists here, this axis cannot be marked disputed and instead shows no vendor-backed performance evidence. missing for 10: published first-party benchmark methodology, latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99), recall metrics for vector/BM25 search, and independent reproduction of any performance claims.
